fullContentHtml:
Bank of Baroda Office Assistant Mains Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the Mains Result for the post Office Assistant (Peon). This recruitment has been issued for 500 posts. Online applying process for Bank of Baroda Office Assistant Recruitment 2025 were Accepted from 03 May 2025 & the candidates can apply till 23 May 2025. The Mains Examination is going to be conducted on 22 March 2026. Candidates who had qualified pre examination can download their Bank of Baroda Office Assistant Mains Result 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 May 2025
  • Last Date : 23 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 23 May 2025
  • Exam Date : 22-23 February 2026
  • Pre Admit Card : 14 February 2026
  • Pre Result : 11 March 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 22 March 2026
  • Mains Admit Card : 12 March 2026
  • Mains Result : 28 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 100/-
  • All Category Female Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
